subject: pharmacology
title: Antiretrovirals: ART classes, PEP, PrEP and IRIS

steps.tx: **NRTI backbones** (**tenofovir**: TDF renal Fanconi with bone loss, TAF safer kidneys and lipids up; **abacavir** **HLA-B*5701** hypersensitivity screened; zidovudine anaemia with lipoatrophy legacy; **lamivudine and emtricitabine** HBV active with **flare on stopping**) chain terminate; **stavudine and didanosine** (lactic acidosis, pancreatitis, neuropathy) retired. Creatinine with phosphate and urine gates TDF years.
steps.say: HLA before abacavir screens fatally: hypersensitivity kills rechallenge. TAF spares kidneys; stopping lamivudine flares HBV.

steps.tx: **NNRTIs** (**efavirenz**: vivid dreams, dizziness, **teratogenic caution** first trimester, CYP induction; **nevirapine**: **hepatotoxic rash** with lead in dosing, CD4 thresholds; **rilpivirine**: meals, **PPI banned**, depression) with **PIs** (**atazanavir**: **unconjugated jaundice** benign with stones; lopinavir and ritonavir diarrhoea with lipids; **darunavir**: sulfa rash, potent boosted) and **INSTIs** (**dolutegravir**: weight, insomnia, neural tube debate settled continue; raltegravir twice daily; bictegravir STR) anchor. Entry (**maraviroc** CCR5 **tropism tested**, enfuvirtide injection site) niches.
steps.say: Efavirenz dreams dizzy; atazanavir yellows benignly. Rilpivirine needs food, never PPI; maraviroc tropism tests.

steps.tx: **First line** (**TAF with FTC plus dolutegravir** single tablet, high barrier, weight watched) with **monitoring** (**viral load** 6 months suppress, **CD4** rise, resistance on failure, adherence counselling) sustains; second line (boosted PI with new backbone) rescues. Pregnancy (dolutegravir continued, efavirenz avoided early) with TB (rifampicin halves dolutegravir doubling dose; efavirenz compatible) co-treats. HBV co-infection never drops tenofovir backbone.
steps.say: Suppressing load 6 months proves first line; rifampicin halves dolutegravir doubling. Never drop tenofovir with HBV.

steps.tx: **PEP** (**within 72 hours**, **28 days**: TDF with FTC plus raltegravir or dolutegravir, baseline with follow up HIV, renal and HBV) after needlestick and sex with **PrEP** (**TDF with FTC daily** or **on demand 2-1-1** MSM, **renal and STI watched**, HIV negative confirmed) prevents; **IRIS** (**paradoxical worsening** weeks after ART: TB nodes, crypto meningitis, **steroids severe**, unmasking) warns. Late presenters stage OI treatment before ART timing.
steps.say: PEP 72 hours 28 days; PrEP daily or 2-1-1 renal STI watched. Paradoxical worsening weeks is IRIS steroiding severe.
